annotations.title: Verify ownership of an MCP server on 7Maps

description: Call when the person owns a server on the map and wants it verified. First call returns proof options; call again with claim_check once the proof is in place. Never changes ranking. Example: {"server":"https://mcp.example.com/mcp"}

alert_url.description: Optional: where to send down and up alerts. An ntfy topic for phone push without email (https://ntfy.sh/<hard-to-guess topic, at least 10 characters>, a self-hosted https://ntfy.<domain>/<topic>, or ntfy:https://<host>/<topic>), a Slack incoming webhook (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...), a Discord webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...), or any https webhook that receives JSON. Stored encrypted, saved only once ownership is proven; a test message is sent on save. An empty string turns alerts off.

claim_check.description: The claim_check from the first call

note.description: Optional plain-text note from the owner, no links, up to 280 characters

owner_secret.description: The owner secret returned once at the first verification. Needed to change an already verified server.

recover.description: Lost the owner secret: true returns a one-time code to put on the host, and a check value

recover_check.description: The check value from the recover step, once its code is on the host

server.description: The MCP server address as it appears on its 7Maps page
